name: gsk
title: GSK (base) algorithm flowchart
note: Single source of truth for the base GSK process flowchart. Clean vertical flow with a junior/senior parallel fork-and-join and a left-placed End; loop-back 'No' returns to the compute-dimensions step. Coordinates are Visio inches, origin bottom-left; 'dx' offsets a node horizontally from the spine.

nodes.text: Initialize population size NP, knowledge factor KF, knowledge ratio KR, top/bottom percentage 100p%, dimension-schedule exponent Kexp
Calculate the fitness of each person of the population
Identify the global best solution in the population
For each person, compute the number of gained and shared dimensions of both phases using the experience equation
For each person, apply the junior gaining-sharing knowledge phase for the desired Djun dimensions
For each person, apply the senior gaining-sharing knowledge phase for the desired (D - Djun) dimensions
Update each person of the population
